Proactively diversify your financial and physical assets, shielding against both market volatility driven by rapid technological shifts and potential economic disruptions stemming from social instability. 2. Strengthen personal and local community preparedness protocols, including emergency supplies and communication plans, in anticipation of potential localized unrest and environmental disruptions, learning from historical flood patterns. 3.
